cohort: The study included 26 women with peripartum cardiomyopathy, with an average age of 22.3 years and an average gestational age of 35.6 weeks, 15 of whom were primigravidae.
finding: Peripartum cardiomyopathy with poor left ventricular ejection fraction and shock is associated with adverse maternal outcomes, while non-severe maternal anemia predisposes to adverse fetal outcomes.
